items.title: AI engineering
items.text: Connect language models to application data and APIs, with explicit boundaries, structured outputs, and human review where it matters.
items.details: AI integration design and implementation for existing products. Start with a defined task and model constraints, connect approved application data, validate model responses, and keep consequential actions behind human review. A local-first Ollama environment is available for experimentation.

items.details: API and webhook integrations, background processing, retry-aware job design, and approval steps for business workflows. AI can assist with classification and drafting while deterministic application logic controls validation, access, and delivery.
